objective: Rank matched passive fin geometries and identify only clear winners or losers that survive the declared two-grid screen.

claim_boundary.allowed_claim: Exploratory relative ranking at the simulated conditions.
prohibited_claims: Ranking differences smaller than numerical sensitivity

conditions.turbulence_model: stock OpenFOAM kOmegaSST with bounded-upwind k and omega convection
conditions.moment_origin: each planar baseline dry CG; ring mass excluded from aerodynamic comparison origin

ranking_rule.drag_metric: last-100 mean Cd at zero degrees; lower is better
ranking_rule.grid_interval: closed interval spanning each design's 20 mm and 15 mm result
ranking_rule.clear_pairwise_drag_winner: winner's entire grid interval is below loser's entire grid interval
ranking_rule.clear_pairwise_drag_loser: loser's entire grid interval is above competitor's entire grid interval
ranking_rule.overall_rule: Do not name an overall winner from drag alone. Report five-degree lift and pitch moment with their grid intervals, and require physically consistent restoring sign before interpreting stability.
ranking_rule.indeterminate_rule: Overlapping grid intervals or a failed quality gate produce no clear ordering.

follow_up: Only designs not clearly eliminated proceed to 20 and 60 m/s checks or additional mesh/orientation sensitivity.
